todo.title: What to do
todo.nothing: Nothing urgent: your price clears your floor with room to spare.
todo.prepaidWhy: A small prepaid discount or coupon means fewer orders refused at the door.
todo.listingWhy: Your returns ({rate}) are above the usual for {category} ({norm}). Clear photos, true colours and a size chart cut returns. This is the effect if returns fall 5 points.
todo.priceWhy: The price helper's suggestion for the {stage} stage.
why.title: Why: what each sale has to cover
why.lead: Spread over the {n} clean sales out of every 100 orders you send.
stage.LAUNCH.aim: From your floor plus a small margin, up to the middle of the market.
stage.GROWING.aim: Try one ₹10 step up, then watch your orders.
stage.STEADY.aim: Hold your price. Don't match a cheaper listing that is below your floor.
stage.CLEARING.aim: Mark down in 5% steps to clear stock. The steps stop at your floor.

privacy.lead: Sahi Daam works on your phone. Here is exactly what is kept, what is never kept, and what is sent.
privacy.stored1: Your shop answers, products, prices and costs.
privacy.stored2: From each report: one total per product (orders, RTO, returns, charges, settlement).
privacy.stored3: Your checks, price steps and the prices of similar products you typed.
privacy.never1: The report file itself. It is read on your phone and then discarded.
privacy.never2: Buyer names, phone numbers and addresses. Those columns are skipped before anything is read.
privacy.sentTitle: Sent to the Sahi Daam team
privacy.sent1: Anonymous usage counts, such as "a report was uploaded, 5 products", with a random device number. Never product names, prices, costs or report data.
privacy.sent2: Your phone number or email, only if you join the Pro waitlist, kept separate from everything else.
privacy.sent3: Your feedback, only if you send it.
privacy.sent4: Category, buyer region, RTO %, returns % and average shipping, only if you turn on anonymous sharing in Me.
privacy.delete1: Me → Delete everything removes all your data from this phone.
privacy.delete2: Clearing this site's data in your browser does the same. Download a backup first if you want to keep it.
privacy.contactNote: Estimates to help you decide. Check with your accountant for tax.
